answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making every credential traceable to witnessed labor. New identities stake collateral, finish unpredictable assignments, and collect signatures from reviewers outside their cluster. A fable of unverified reputation is rejected outright; only signed results stand. A timber of bonded stake backs each claim, and a quill records every attestation so copied behavior surfaces during audits. Slashing makes swarms expensive while honest agents compound trust.
